steps.npc: Hello traveller, how's things?
I'm good, just working hard as usual...

options.text: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.

steps.player: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.

steps.npc: Hmmmmmm... I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!
For the full setup, 750,000 coins. Or I can sell you the separate parts... but it'll cost extra!

options.text: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.

steps.player: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.

steps.text: If the player has less than six free inventory space:

steps.npc: Okay. There are four pieces to carry, plus the mould and instruction book, so you'll need to free up some space.

steps.text: If the player has at least 750,000 coins and enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Okay then, but keep it quiet... This thing's top secret!

steps.text: You give the cannon engineer 750,000 coins. He gives you the four parts that make the cannon, plus an ammo mould and an instruction manual.

steps.npc: There you go, you be careful with that thing.
Take care, adventurer.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 750,000 coins:

steps.npc: Okay, come back when you've got the 750,000 coins.

options.text: Can I look at the separate parts please?

steps.player: Can I look at the separate parts please?

steps.npc: Of course!

options.text: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?

steps.player: Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?

steps.npc: Of course!

options.text: Sorry, that's too much for me.

steps.player: Sorry, that's too much for me.

steps.npc: Fair enough, it's too much for most of us.

steps.text: If the player's cannon is still set-up somewhere:

steps.npc: Hmmm. I think you'll find it's still happily parked on the spot where you put it.

steps.player: Oh, is it still there? I thought I'd lost it.

steps.npc: Ha ha ha, what a muddle-headed numpty you are!

steps.text: If the player has less than 4 free inventory space:

steps.npc: That's unfortunate! But don't worry, I can sort you out if you free up some inventory space...
That's unfortunate! But don't worry, I can sort you out...

steps.text: If the player has lost their cannon by world-hopping or letting it despawn:
The dwarf gives you a new cannon.

steps.npc: Keep that quiet or I'll be in real trouble!

steps.text: If the player still has their cannon:

steps.npc: Actually, I'm only allowed to replace cannons that were stolen in action. I'm sorry, but you'll have to buy a new set.

options.text: I want to know more about the cannon.

steps.player: I want to know more about the cannon.

steps.npc: There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
In short bursts it's very effective, the most destructive weapon to date. The cannon automatically targets monsters close by. You just have to make the ammo and let rip.

options.text: Well, take care of yourself then.

steps.player: Well, take care of yourself then.

steps.npc: Indeed I will adventurer.
